thread:
maya: Hey folks — decluttering my WFH corner. Free to a good home: Shure SM7B (excellent condition) + Cloudlifter CL-1 + 10ft XLR cable + K&M boom arm. No interface included. Curbside SF pickup (SoMa). Pics: https://imgur.com/example (posted).

sanjay: Still available? :eyes:

maya: Yep, still here. Had it for a year, mostly for podcast tests. Kept in a smoke-free apartment.

ton y: (typo) oops meant to say tony: Any noise floor issues? Do you need a preamp?

maya: @tony Good q — SM7B is gain-hungry. The Cloudlifter helps a lot (gives +20dB), but you'll still want an audio interface with decent preamps or a Samson-like mic pre. Works great with a Focusrite Scarlett 2i2 or Rode AI-1.

kelly: Would love to test it before committing. Do you come into the office this week?

maya: I can bring it to the SF office on Thurs afternoon. Or curbside pickup anytime this weekend.

tony: If no one claims, I can swing by Thurs. I run a small podcast so I'd put it to good use.

sanjay: Would you accept a small trade instead of free? I have a Logitech StreamCam + tripod I'm looking to swap if that helps.

maya: I'm prioritizing local pickup but open to swaps if it's even. StreamCam could be useful — I'm actually looking for a webcam for remote meetings.

kelly: Can you post a quick photo of the wiring/serial? Want to check for wear.

maya: Sure — uploaded two pics in the thread. Also here's a quick note I pasted from the Cloudlifter manual: ```Use a balanced mic cable and 48V phantom power is *not* used by the CL-1. It provides clean gain before the preamp.```

depot-bot: Note: Please do not leave items in the office common areas overnight. Arrange pickup time or use the building lobby drop.

maya: Thanks @depot-bot — pickup scheduled Thurs 2:30pm at the SoMa lobby. First person to confirm in-thread gets it.

tony: Confirming — I'll take it if still there after Kelly checks. :+1:

kelly: I'll swing by at 2pm to test quickly. If it checks out, I'll take it or confirm by 2:15.

maya: Sounds good. If Kelly passes, Tony gets dibs. If both pass, @sanjay we can discuss the webcam trade.

sanjay: Cool — thanks for being flexible.

maya: Happy to see it go to someone who'll use it. If anyone wants measurements: boom arm reach ~80cm, mic weight ~765g with mount.

kelly: Quick Q — is the shock mount included?

maya: Yes, original SM7B mount and a spare pop filter included.

tony: Thanks — see you Thurs. :wave:

kelly: Thanks @maya!
